Steps to create an entry

2. Choose your numbers: For a standard marked entry, choose 6 numbers from 1 to 45 or use the autofill option.

Winning combinations

There are 6 TattsLotto prize divisions. The winning combinations and odds of winning each TattsLotto prize division (based on 1 standard game) are shown below.

6 winning numbersOdds of winning (based on 1 standard game) are 8,145,060:1
5 winning numbers + 1 supplementaryOdds of winning (based on 1 standard game) 678,755:1
5 winning numbersOdds of winning (based on 1 standard game) are 36,690:1
4 winning numbersOdds of winning (based on 1 standard game) are 733:1
3 winning numbers + 1 supplementaryOdds of winning (based on 1 standard game) are 298:1
3 winning numbersOdds of winning (based on 1 standard game) are 53:1

Ways to Play

A System entry gives you the option to play more than the standard 6 numbers in a TattsLotto game. You can choose from 7 to 20 numbers giving you more chances to win.
